name: Birth of Napoleon
description: Napoleon Bonaparte is born in Corsica, France.

name: Coronation of Napoleon
description: Napoleon Bonaparte is crowned Emperor of the French.

name: Napoleonic Code
description: The Napoleonic Code, a French civil code, is adopted.

name: Battle of Austerlitz
description: Napoleon achieves a decisive victory against the Austro-Russian army.

name: Treaty of Tilsit
description: France and Russia sign a peace treaty, marking the height of Napoleon's power.

name: Peninsular War
description: Napoleon invades Spain and Portugal, sparking a long and costly conflict.

name: Invasion of Russia
description: Napoleon leads a disastrous invasion of Russia with the Grand Army.

name: Battle of Leipzig
description: Also known as the Battle of Nations, Napoleon is defeated by the Sixth Coalition.

name: First Abdication
description: Napoleon abdicates as Emperor and is exiled to the island of Elba.

name: Hundred Days
description: Napoleon briefly returns to power in France.

name: Battle of Waterloo
description: Napoleon's final defeat against the Seventh Coalition led by the Duke of Wellington.

name: Second Abdication
description: Napoleon abdicates for the second time and is exiled to the island of Saint Helena.

name: Death of Napoleon
description: Napoleon Bonaparte dies on the island of Saint Helena.
